mapper.sql: (SELECT MIN(IF(s.is_discount = 1 AND s.discount_price IS NOT NULL, s.discount_price, s.price)) FROM tb_sku s WHERE s.product_id = p.id AND s.status = 1 AND s.deleted = 0)
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.subtitle, p.cover_img AS coverImg, p.detail_html AS detailHtml, p.sale_type AS saleType, p.is_near_expiry AS isNearExpiry, p.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, p.sales, b.name AS brandName, c.name AS categoryName FROM tb_product p LEFT JOIN tb_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.cover_img AS coverImg, b.name AS brandName, AS minPrice FROM tb_product p LEFT JOIN tb_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.shelf_status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR p.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.name LIKE CONCAT(#{kw}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN p.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, p.sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_product p LEFT JOIN tb_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.shelf_status = 1 AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR p.subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR b.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{kw}, '%') )

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.subtitle, p.cover_img AS coverImg, p.sale_type AS saleType, p.is_near_expiry AS isNearExpiry, p.sales, b.name AS brandName, c.name AS categoryName, AS minPrice FROM tb_product p LEFT JOIN tb_brand b ON b.id = p.brand_id AND b.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_category c ON c.id = p.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.shelf_status = 1 AND p.id IN #{id}
